54800.meaning1: who has eradicated lust and hatred; who has destroyed desire and ill-will

examples.text: avihaṃ upapannāse, vimuttā satta bhikkhavo, rāgadosaparikkhīṇā, tiṇṇā loke visattikan'ti.

54801.meaning1: afflicted with desire and hatred; overwhelmed by craving and aversion

examples.text: kicchena me adhigataṃ, h'alaṃ dāni pakāsituṃ, rāgadosaparetehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.

54802.meaning1: passion, hatred and delusion; craving, aversion and confusion
54802.compound: dvanda (rāga ca dosa ca moha ca)

examples.text: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena upasam'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. eso hi, bhikkhu, paramo ariyo upasamo yadidaṃ, rāgadosamohānaṃ upasamo.

santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino saki'd'eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass'antaṃ karissanti, evarūpā'pi, bhikkhave, santi bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe.

54803.meaning1: wearing away of desire, hatred and delusion
54803.meaning2: wearing away of desire, hatred and delusion
54803.commentary: (DNa) rāgadosamohakkhayā sa nibbuto'ti so imaṃ pāpakaṃ jahitvā rāg'ādīnaṃ khayā kilesanibbānena nibbuto'ti.

examples.text: dadato puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, saṃyamato veraṃ na cīyati, kusalo ca jahāti pāpakaṃ, rāgadosamohakkhayā sanibbuto'ti.

54804.meaning1: struggling with greed, hatred and delusion

54805.meaning1: removal of craving and aversion; dispelling of desire and hatred

examples.text: ye rāgadosavinayā, avijjāsamatikkamā, sekkhā apacay'ārāmā, appamatt'ānusikkhare, te namassāmi mātalī'ti.

54806.meaning1: sign of desire; object of lust

examples.text: animittā cetovimuttī'ti arahattaphalasamāpatti. sā hi rāganimitt'ādīnañ'c'eva rūpanimitt'ādīnañ'ca niccanimitt'ādīnañ'ca abhāvā animittā'ti vuttā. nimitt'ānusārī'ti vuttappabhedaṃ nimittaṃ anusaratī'ti nimittānusārī.

54807.meaning1: based on passion; supported by craving; dependent on desire

examples.text: yassa chattiṃsati sotā, manāpasavanā bhusā, vāhā vahanti duddiṭṭhiṃ, saṅkappā rāganissitā.

54809.meaning1: path of passion; way of lust; sensuality (in)

examples.text: disvāna rūpāni manoramāni, atho'pi disvāna amanoramāni, manorame rāgapathaṃ vinodaye, na c'āppiyaṃ me'ti manaṃ padosaye.

54810.meaning1: obsessed by lust; consumed by desire; possessed by greed
54810.commentary: (ANa) n'ev'assa rāgapariyuṭṭhitan'ti na uppajjamānena rāgena uṭṭhahitvā gahitaṃ.

examples.text: yasmiṃ, mahānāma, samaye ariyasāvako tathāgataṃ anussarati n'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, ujugatam'ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti tathāgataṃ ārabbha.

54811.meaning1: afflicted with lust; overcome by passion
54811.commentary: (ANa) rāgapariyuṭṭhito'mhi, āvuso, rāgapareto'ti ahaṃ, āvuso, rāgena ratto, rāgena anugato.

examples.text: so rāg'ānuddhaṃsitena cittena pariḍayhateva kāyena pariḍayhati cetasā. tassa evaṃ hoti, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ āroceyyaṃ, rāgapariyuṭṭhito'mhi, āvuso, rāgapareto, na sakkomi brahmacariyaṃ sandhāretuṃ, sikkhādubbalyaṃ āvikatvā sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissāmī'ti.

54812.meaning1: snare of sensual desire; trap of lust

examples.text: ken'āsi dummano tāta, purisaṃ kaṃ nu socasi, mayaṃ taṃ rāgapāsena, āraññam'iva kuñjaraṃ, bandhitvā ānayissāma, vasago te bhavissatī'ti.

ye kho, āvuso, rāgappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, dosappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, mohappahānāya dhammaṃ desenti, te loke dhammavādino. ye kho, āvuso, rāgassa pahānāya paṭipannā, dosassa pahānāya paṭipannā, mohassa pahānāya paṭipannā, te loke suppaṭipannā.

54824.meaning1: imprisoned by desire; held captive by lust
54824.meaningLit: bound with the bond of desire

examples.text: pubbe kho, gāmaṇi, sattā avītarāgā rāgabandhanabaddhā. tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā rajanīyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya.

54825.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

54826.meaning1: filled with passion; infatuated with lust

examples.text: ye rāgaratt'ānupatanti sotaṃ, sayaṃkataṃ makkaṭako'va jālaṃ, etam'pi chetvāna vajanti dhīrā, anapekkhino sabbadukkhaṃ pahāya.
āsīsanti thomayanti abhijappanti juhanti, kām'ābhijappanti paṭicca lābhaṃ, te yājayogā bhavarāgarattā, n'ātariṃsu jātijaran'ti brūmi.

54827.meaning1: who is infatuated by infatuation; who desires desire; who is attached to attachment
54827.commentary: (NIDD1) na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto'ti yato kāmarāgo ca rūparāgo ca arūparāgo ca pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. ettāvatā na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto. (SNPa) so ca kāmarāg'ābhāvato na rāgarāgī, rūp'ārūparāg'ābhāvato na virāgaratto.

examples.text: sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.

54828.meaning1: like desire; like passion; equal to lust

examples.text: n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo kali, n'atthi khandhasamā dukkhā, n'atthi santiparaṃ sukhaṃ.
n'atthi rāgasamo aggi, n'atthi dosasamo gaho, n'atthi mohasamaṃ jālaṃ, n'atthi taṇhāsamā nadī.

54830.meaning1: due to desire; under the influence of lust

examples.text: tiṭṭhaṃ naro mohanasmiṃ pagāḷho'ti tiṭṭhanto naro ratto rāgavasena tiṭṭhati, duṭṭho dosavasena tiṭṭhati, mūḷho mohavasena tiṭṭhati, vinibaddho mānavasena tiṭṭhati, parāmaṭṭho diṭṭhivasena tiṭṭhati, vikkhepagato uddhaccavasena tiṭṭhati…

54831.meaning1: removal of lust; dispelling of desire

examples.text: ime kho no, āvuso, ākārā, ime anvayā, yena mayaṃ evaṃ vadema, addhā te āyasmanto vītarāgā vā rāgavinayāya vā paṭipannā, vītadosā vā dosavinayāya vā paṭipannā, vītamohā vā mohavinayāya vā paṭipannā'ti.

54832.commentary: (SNa) idāni'ssa niddosabhāvañ'c'eva saṅgāma-vijaya-bhāvañ'ca dassento rāga-vinaya-pariyosānā'ti-ādim'āha. tattha rāgaṃ vinayamānā pariyosāpeti pariyosānaṃ gacchati nipphajjatī'ti rāgavinayapariyosānā. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ… sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.

54833.meaningLit: discourse on the removal of lust

54834.meaning1: bound by lust; shackled by desire (for)

examples.text: rūpadhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. rūpadhāturāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.

54835.meaning1: fading of desire; disappearance of lust
54835.commentary: (ANa) rāgavirāgā cetovimuttī'ti rāgassa khayavirāgena cetovimutti nāma hoti. phalasamādhiss'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: rāg'upakkiliṭṭhaṃ vā, bhikkhave, cittaṃ na vimuccati, avijj'upakkiliṭṭhā vā paññā bhāvīyati. iti kho, bhikkhave, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti.
nanu mayā, moghapurisa, anekapariyāyena rāgavirāgāya dhammo desito

54836.meaning1: for the fading of desire; for the disappearance of lust; for the sake of dispassion
54836.construction:
rāga + virāga + attha + aṃ
rāgavirāgattha + aṃ

examples.text: rāgavirāg'atthaṃ khv'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmī'ti.

54837.meaningLit: discourse on the fading of desire

54838.meaning1: with and without lust; who is attached and unattached

examples.text: paroparañ'ca jānāsi, atho rāgavirāginaṃ, itthabhāv'aññathābhāvaṃ, sattānaṃ āgatiṃ gatin'ti.

54839.meaning1: abundance of desire; massive amount of passion

examples.text: katame cattāro? rāgavepullattaṃ, dosavepullattaṃ, mohavepullattaṃ, gambhīresu kho pan'assa ṭhān'āṭhānesu paññācakkhu na kamati. yo hi koci, āvuso, bhikkhu vā bhikkhunī vā ime cattāro dhamme attani samanupassati, niṭṭham'ettha gantabbaṃ, parihāyāmi kusalehi dhammehi.

54840.meaning1: absence of lust etc.; non existence of passion, hatred and delusion

examples.text: evaṃ rāg'ādivirahena cakkhuviññāṇamattam'eva me javanaṃ bhavissati, cakkhuviññāṇ'appamāṇen'eva javanaṃ ṭhapessāmī'ti.

54841.meaning1: because of desire; due to lust

examples.text: katamā tisso? yaṃ ratto rāg'ādhikaraṇaṃ attabyābādhāya'pi ceteti, parabyābādhāya'pi ceteti, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi ceteti. rāge pahīne n'ev'attabyābādhāya ceteti, na parabyābādhāya ceteti, na ubhayabyābādhāya ceteti.
subhāny'appaṭikūlāni, phoṭṭhabbāni anussaraṃ, ratto rāg'ādhikaraṇaṃ, vividhaṃ vindate dukhaṃ.

54842.meaning1: invaded by lust; filled with desire; overtaken by passion

examples.text: so rāg'ānuddhaṃsena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigacchati maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ. maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.

54843.meaning1: invaded by lust; overwhelmed with passion

examples.text: so tattha passati mātugāmaṃ dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā. tassa mātugāmaṃ disvā dunnivatthaṃ vā duppārutaṃ vā rāgo cittaṃ anuddhaṃseti. so rāg'ānuddhaṃsitena cittena sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati.
so rāg'ānuddhaṃsitena cittena maraṇaṃ vā nigaccheyya maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhaṃ.
so sabbaso rāg'ānusayaṃ pahāya paṭigh'ānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā asmī'ti diṭṭhimān'ānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hoti
sukhāya, bhikkhave, vedanāya rāg'ānusayo pahātabbo, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭigh'ānusayo pahātabbo, adukkham'asukhāya vedanāya avijj'ānusayo pahātabbo.

54845.meaning1: having the underlying tendency towards desire

examples.text: sukhaṃ vedayamānassa, vedanaṃ appajānato, so rāg'ānusayo hoti, anissaraṇadassino.

54847.meaning1: who desires; who is passionate about; who is infatuated
54847.commentary: (NIDD1) na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto'ti yato kāmarāgo ca rūparāgo ca arūparāgo ca pahīnā honti ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. ettāvatā na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto. (SNPa) so ca kāmarāg'ābhāvato na rāgarāgī, rūp'ārūparāg'ābhāvato na virāgaratto.

examples.text: sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.

54848.meaning1: defiled by lust; contaminated with desire

examples.text: rāg'upakkiliṭṭhaṃ vā, bhikkhave, cittaṃ na vimuccati, avijj'upakkiliṭṭhā vā paññā bhāvīyati. iti kho, bhikkhave, rāgavirāgā cetovimutti, avijjāvirāgā paññāvimuttī'ti.

54849.commentary: (VINa) rāg'ūpatthambhe'ti rāgassa balavabhāve, rāgena vā aṅgajātassa upatthambhe, thaddhabhāve sañjāte'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: rāg'ūpatthambhe'ti rāgena pīḷitassa aṅgajātaṃ kammaniyaṃ hoti.

54850.meaning1: connected with lust; to do with desire; provocative of passion
54850.commentary: (SNa) subhaṃ rāg'ūpasaṃhitan'ti rāgavaḍḍhan'ārammaṇaṃ subhaṃ parivajjento asubhasaññāya parivajjeyya, sabbattha anabhiratisaññāya.

examples.text: saññāya vipariyesā, cittaṃ te pariḍayhati, nimittaṃ parivajjehi, subhaṃ rāg'ūpasaṃhitaṃ.

54851.synonym: adhipati, inda, issara, deva, pati, sāmī

examples.text: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissa rājā vā rājabhoggo vā brāhmaṇo vā gahapatiko vā dūtena cīvaracetāpannaṃ pahiṇeyya, iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthan'nāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādehī'ti.

khat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. upahat'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā. sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā pitaraṃ dhammikaṃ dhammarājānaṃ jīvitā na voropessatha, imasmiññ'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ uppajjissathā'ti.
sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

54853.meaning1: principle which does not cause the decline of a king

examples.text: tāsaṃ kho pana, bhante, bhaginīnaṃ evarūpo gandho hoti, seyyathā'pi nāma gandhakaraṇḍakassa tāva'd'eva vivariyamānassa, yathā taṃ rājakaññānaṃ gandhena vibhūsitānaṃ.
ādāya dantāni gaj'uttamassa, vaggū subhe appaṭime pathabyā, suvaṇṇarājīhi samantamodare, so luddako kāsipuraṃ upāgami, upanesi so rājakaññāya dante, nāgo hato handa imassa dantā.
ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ disampatimhi raññe kālaṅ'kate rājakattāro bhavantaṃ reṇuṃ rajje abhisiñceyyuṃ.

54858.meaning1: talk of kings; discussion about rulers
54858.commentary: (ANa) tattha rājānaṃ ārabbha, mahāsammato mandhātā dhammāsoko evaṃmah'ānubhāvo'ti-ādinā nayena pavattakathā rājakathā.

examples.text: rājakathaṃ corakathaṃ mah'āmattakathaṃ senākathaṃ bhayakathaṃ yuddhakathaṃ annakathaṃ pānakathaṃ vatthakathaṃ sayanakathaṃ mālākathaṃ gandhakathaṃ ñātikathaṃ yānakathaṃ gāmakathaṃ

54860.meaning1: obligation to the king; responsibility to the ruler

examples.text: kuto, bho sāriputta, amhākaṃ appamādo yesaṃ no… mitt'āmaccānaṃ mitt'āmaccakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ñātisālohitānaṃ ñātisālohitakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, atithīnaṃ atithikaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, pubbapetānaṃ pubbapetakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, devatānaṃ devatākaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, rañño rājakaraṇīyaṃ kātabbaṃ, ayam'pi kāyo pīṇetabbo brūhetabbo'ti?

adhivāsetu kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pañcak'aṅgassa thapatissa svātanāya attacatuttho bhattaṃ, yena ca kira, bhante, āyasmā anuruddho pagevataraṃ āgaccheyya, pañcak'aṅgo, bhante, thapati bahukicco bahukaraṇīyo rājakaraṇīyenā'ti. adhivāsesi kho āyasmā anuruddho tuṇhībhāvena.

54861.commentary: (MNa) rājak'ārāmo'ti pasenadinā kārito nagarassa dakkhiṇadisābhāge thūp'ārāmasadise ṭhāne vihāro.

examples.text: sāvatthiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto attadutiyo yena rājak'ārāmo ten'upasaṅkami.

54862.meaning2: Chapter 2 of the Sotāpattisaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe. atha kho abhayo rājakumāro yena nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā nigaṇṭhaṃ nāṭaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
satthari hi paṭhamagamanena kapilapuraṃ gantvā kaniṭṭhabhātikaṃ nandarājakumāraṃ pabbājetvā kapilapurā nikkhamma anupubbena sāvatthiṃ gantvā viharante āyasmā nando anabhirato ahosi

54864.meaning1: one hundred royal maidens; one hundred ladies-in-waiting

examples.text: atha kho sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnā kho sumanā rājakumārī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

54869.meaning1: amidst the royal court; among royalty

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

54871.meaning1: royal food; royal cuisine; king's food

examples.text: sūro yathā rājakhādāya puṭṭho, abhigajjam'eti paṭisūram'icchaṃ, yen'eva so tena palehi sūra, pubb'eva n'atthi yadidaṃ yudhāya.

54872.meaning1: name of a city; capital of Magadha; modern day Rajgir
54872.commentary: (MNa) rājagahe'ti evaṃnāmake nagare, tañ'hi mandhātumahāgovind'ādīhi pariggahitattā rājagahan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, idha puriso āgaccheyya rājagahaṃ gantu'kāmo. so taṃ upasaṅkamitvā evaṃ vadeyya, icchām'ahaṃ, bhante, rājagahaṃ gantuṃ, tassa me rājagahassa maggaṃ upadisā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena āyasmā soṇo rājagahe viharati sītavanasmiṃ. atha kho āyasmato soṇassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
tena kho pana samayena rājagahakassa seṭṭhissa sattavassiko sīs'ābādho hoti. bahū mahantā mahantā disāpāmokkhā vejjā āgantvā n'āsakkhiṃsu arogaṃ kātuṃ.

54874.meaning1: going to Rājagaha; headed to Rājagaha

examples.text: tena hi, brāhmaṇa, taṃ'y'ev'ettha paṭipucchissāmi. yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ byākareyyāsi. taṃ kiṃ maññasi, brāhmaṇa, kusalo tvaṃ rājagahagāmissa maggassā'ti?

54876.meaning1: at Rājagaha; Rājagaha is the location; set in Rājagaha

examples.text: rājagahanidānaṃ. ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho uttaro devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

54879.commentary: (DNa) kumbhīro rājagahiko'ti rājagahanagare nibbatto kumbhīro nāma yakkho.

examples.text: kumbhīro rājagahiko, vepullassa nivesanaṃ, bhiyyo naṃ satasahassaṃ, yakkhānaṃ payirupāsati, kumbhīro rājagahiko, so'p'āgā samitiṃ vanaṃ.

54880.meaning1: located near to Rājagaha; (comm) mountains around Rājagaha

examples.text: vipulo rājagahīyānaṃ, giriseṭṭho pavuccati, seto himavataṃ seṭṭho, ādicco aghagāminaṃ.

54881.meaning1: (of a horse) special behaviour for a king; qualities befitting a king
54881.meaning2: royal qualities; characteristics of a king
54881.commentary: (MNa) rājaguṇe'ti raññā jānitabbaguṇe. kūṭakaṇṇarañño kira guḷavaṇṇo nāma asso ahosi. rājā pācīnadvārena nikkhamitvā cetiyapabbataṃ gamissāmī'ti kalambanadītīraṃ sampatto. asso tīre ṭhatvā udakaṃ otarituṃ na icchati, rājā ass'ācariyaṃ āmantetvā, aho tayā asso sikkhāpito udakaṃ otarituṃ na icchatī'ti āha. ācariyo, susikkhāpito deva asso, evam'assa hi cittaṃ sac'āhaṃ udakaṃ otarissāmi, vālaṃ temissati, vāle tinte rañño aṅge udakaṃ pāteyyā'ti evaṃ tumhākaṃ sarīre udakapātanabhayena na otarati, vālaṃ gaṇhāpethā'ti āha. rājā tathā kāresi. asso vegena otaritvā pāraṃ gato. etadatthaṃ ayaṃ kāraṇā karīyati.

examples.text: yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti anukkame maṇḍale khurakāse dhāve davatte rājaguṇe rājavaṃse uttame jave uttame haye uttame sākhalye.

54883.meaning1: with a tax-value; with a customs-value
54883.commentary: (VINa) rāj'aggaṃ bhaṇḍan'ti rāj'ārahaṃ bhaṇḍaṃ, yato rañño pañcamāsakaṃ vā atirekapañcamāsakaṃ vā agghanakaṃ suṅkaṃ dātabbaṃ hoti, taṃ bhaṇḍan'ti attho. rājakan'ti'pi pāṭho, ayam'ev'attho.

54884.meaning1: component of royalty; part of a king's regalia
54884.commentary: (DNa) rāj'ārahānī'ti rañño anurūpāni hatthi-ass'ādīni, tāni'y'eva rañño senāya aṅgabhūtattā rāj'aṅgānī'ti vuccanti.

examples.text: rājā samāno kiṃ labhati? yāni tāni rāj'ārahāni rāj'aṅgāni rāj'ūpabhogāni rāj'ānucchavikāni tāni khippaṃ paṭilabhati.
rājā te sabbe gāhāpetvā rāj'aṅgaṇe nābhippamāṇe āvāṭe khaṇāpetvā te tattha nisīdāpetvā paṃsūhi pūretvā upari palāle vikirāpetvā aggiṃ dāpesi.

54887.meaning1: man of the ruling class; young noble

examples.text: atha kho pāyāsi rājañño uttaraṃ māṇavaṃ āmantāpetvā etadavoca, saccaṃ kira tvaṃ, tāta uttara, dānaṃ datvā evaṃ anuddisasi, imin'āhaṃ dānena pāyāsiṃ rājaññam'eva imasmiṃ loke samāgacchiṃ, mā parasmin'ti
abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, rājañña, divā seyyaṃ upagato supinakaṃ passitā ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakan'ti?
āyantu bhonto ye tattha khattiyakulā brāhmaṇakulā rājaññakulā uppannā, sākassa vā sālassa vā salaḷassa vā candanassa vā padumakassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontu.

54890.grammar: masc, abl sg of rāja, atta group
54890.meaning1: from the king; from the government

examples.text: rājato vā upasaggaṃ, abbhakkhānañ'ca dāruṇaṃ, parikkhayañ'ca ñātīnaṃ, bhogānañ'ca pabhaṅguraṃ.

54892.commentary: (SNa) rājadaṇḍenā'ti rañño uddhaṭadaṇḍena, so appako nāma na hoti, dasasahassa-vīsatisahassa-ppamāṇo hoti'y'eva.

examples.text: ṭhānañ'hi so manuj'indo, rajjaṃ laddhāna khattiyo, so kuddho rājadaṇḍena, tasmiṃ pakkamate bhusaṃ, tasmā taṃ parivajjeyya, rakkhaṃ jīvitam'attano.
tvaññ'eva no citta karosi brāhmaṇo, tvaṃ khattiyo rājadasī karosi, vessā ca suddā ca bhavāma ekadā, devattanaṃ vā'pi tav'eva vāhasā.

54895.meaning1: royal grant; gift from the king

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opāsādaṃ ajjhāvasati satt'ussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭh'odakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
te pesitā rājadūtā, piṭṭhito anubandhisuṃ, kuhiṃ gamissati bhikkhu, kattha vāso bhavissati.

54898.meaning1: royal responsibility; duty of a king

examples.text: atīte kururaṭṭhe indapattanagare dhanañcaye rajjaṃ kārente bodhisatto tassa aggamahesiyā kucchismiṃ paṭisandhiṃ gahetvā anupubbena viññutaṃ patto takkasilāyaṃ sippāni uggahetvā pitarā uparajje patiṭṭhāpito aparabhāge pitu accayena rajjaṃ patvā dasa rājadhamme akopento kurudhamme vattittha.
